title: Audit a complete Automatic Tune sequence
equipment: Recirculating electric water heater with independent candidate-validation copy
physicalPurpose: Automate the evidence and decision sequence without concealing failure, promoting Simulation evidence, or applying gains.
objective: Run and audit Automatic Tune for a recirculating water heater, explain why each stage passes or stops, recover from the taught failures, and export one validated but unapplied controller recommendation.

simplifications: The saved simulated FOPDT configuration is exact model evidence
The candidate drives an independent copy and does not replace the running controller
Equivalent deterministic sensor interference and load events
Local linear operating region and one-sided ideal heater inside declared limits

baseline.limitation: A manually reviewed controller does not yet prove that the complete automatic evidence, candidate, failure, and recovery sequence is inspectable and fail-closed.

change.decision: Accept the workflow only when every stage and failure remains inspectable, the recommendation is validated, and the running controller revision remains unchanged.

failureScenarios.name: missing selected plant
failureScenarios.recovery: save the selected simulated plant configuration

failureScenarios.name: invalid or unsupported saved model
failureScenarios.recovery: correct parameters or collect and identify supported data

failureScenarios.name: unsafe requested excitation
failureScenarios.recovery: review signal, bound, duration, topology, stops, and restoration

failureScenarios.name: poor or insufficient observed data
failureScenarios.recovery: design a more informative bounded experiment

failureScenarios.name: no applicable tuning method
failureScenarios.recovery: review model domain and controller design route

failureScenarios.name: no acceptable controller
failureScenarios.recovery: review failed requirements without weakening them

failureScenarios.name: restoration failure
failureScenarios.recovery: remain stopped and require explicit operator recovery

disturbances: A minus-1-degC equilibrium-temperature load at 100 s
Model-predicted setpoint, load, noise, and bounded-variation validation

acceptance.window: 10 through 220 s candidate IAE minus current IAE
10 through 220 s candidate total variation minus current total variation

abortPredicates: Any required identity, revision, unit, quality, freshness, model parameter, sample, limit, event, seed, requirement, or restoration state is missing or inconsistent
Any process value or applied output leaves its hard limit
Any unplanned, enlarged, repeated, stale, or physical action is requested
The active controller revision changes before a separate authorised Apply review
safety.restorationMode: Stop the bounded experiment, restore the reviewed 20-degC setpoint and 20-percent heater command, and verify observed mode, output, temperature, and restoration state before another plan.
safety.physicalApprovalRole: authorised process controls engineer and responsible water-heater operator
simulationOnlyRestrictions: No physical excitation, application, or rollback is performed
Exact Simulation configuration evidence cannot be promoted to recorded or physical evidence
Physical actions require independent topology and hazard review plus explicit immediate approval for each exact action

video.viewerOutcome: Audit Automatic Tune from plan through validated export and diagnose every failure without allowing silent excitation or application.

learning.context: A confirmed Robust heater PI remains active while an independent simulated copy validates the Balanced recommendation.
learning.reason: The learner now understands each tuning decision and can judge whether automation sequences it transparently and safely.
theory: Automatic Tune orchestrates existing Test, Identify, Tune, and Validate services.
Exact Simulation configuration may be reused without pretending it was identified from observed plant data.
Every failure stops at its owning stage, retains valid evidence, and leaves application separately authorised.
learning.workedPrediction: Predict zero excitation, the four-stage sequence, accepted FOPDT parameters, Balanced SIMC Kp 5.769 and Ti 5.000 s, about 13.5 s settling, and an unapplied result.
practicalPreparation: Verify source, identities, revisions, units, quality, operating point, mode, limits, current controller, plan, reuse decision, methods, structures, requirements, restoration, and export-only authority.
Record expected stage and recovery for each success and failure case before confirmation.
learning.baseline: The confirmed Robust PI is safe and valid but the automatic evidence and failure sequence is not yet demonstrated.
learning.change: Confirm one exact-simulation Automatic Tune plan and separately exercise each deterministic failure and recovery branch.
learning.comparison: Compare running and candidate controllers with one immutable validation record, then compare planned versus executed orchestration states and unchanged controller revision.
learning.validation: Require exact stage order, zero excitation, formula and requirement agreement, fail-closed branches, observed restoration, unapplied export, and unchanged active revision.
learning.explanation: The exact-simulation path is short because accepted configuration evidence is reusable; unknown or physical plants still require bounded approved experiments and independent model validation.
learning.transfer: Use automation to reproduce visible engineering decisions, never to conceal uncertainty, promote evidence, weaken requirements, or grant itself authority to act.
